SST *○ TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TO SECTION 81-642 OF THE ZONING RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF NEWYORK This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights is made as of the 15th day ofOctober, 2021, by and between THE VESTRY OF ST. BARTHOLOMEW'S CHURCH York 10022 ("Transferor"), and 415 MADISON AVENUE LLC, with an address at 345 Park Avenue, New York, New York 10154 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution"), the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission of the City of New York (the “CPC Chairperson") shall allow, by certification, the distribution of floor area that is generated by a “granting lot" located in the East Midtown Subdistrict of the Special Midtown District (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution) to a “receiving lot" located in one or more subareas other than the Vanderbilt Corridor Subarea of the East Midtown Subdistrict (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Block Resolution); and WHEREAS, Transferor is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, which property is designated as Block 1305, Lot 1 1305 on the Tax Map of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit A attached hereto Tr WHEREAS, Transferee is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 1284, Lot 21 on the Tax Map of 1 New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Receiving Lot"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is located in the East Midtown Subdistrict, partially within a C5-3 zoning district in the Park Avenue Subarea and partially within a C5-2.5 zoning district, which is located partially in the Park Avenue Subarea and partially in the Blsck Other Transit Improvement Zone Subarea; and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot is improved with certain buildings, which are + designated as a New York City landmark, and is a “granting lot,”' as defined in Section 81- 613 of the Zoning Resolution; and Lot WHEREAS, the maximum amount of floor area that may be transferred from a granting lot shall be the applicable basic maximum floor area as set forth in Section 81-64 of the Zoning Resolution, less the total floor area of all existing buildings on the zoning lot, and any previously transferred floor area; and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot has a lot area of 47,699 square feet, with 25,105 square feet located in the C5-3 zoning district and 22,594 square feet located in the C5-2.5 zoning district; and 1

WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 81-64 and 81-211 of the Zoning Resolution, the maximum permitted FAR in the C5-3 zoning district is 15.0 and the maximum permitted FAR in the C5-2.5 zoning district is 12.0; and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot generates 647,703 square feet of floor area, and WHEREAS, the Granting Lot currently has development amounting to 69,218.2 square feet of floor area on site, leaving a maximum of 578,484.8 square feet available for transfer pursuant to Section 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution, and WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is located in a C5-3 zoning district in the Southern SubareaoftheEastMidtownSubdistrict;and WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot is a “receiving lot,” as defined in Section 81-613 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the Receiving Lot has a total lot area of 11,674 square feet; and WHEREAS,theincreasedfloor area allowedbythe transferof development rights pursuant to Section 81-642 shall not exceed the amount resulting in the maximum floor areassetforthinSection81-64,and WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution, the Receiving Lot has a basic maximum permitted FAR of 15.0, which may be increased to up to 21.6 in the Southern Subarea by retaining non-complying floor area in commercial buildings or by the distribution of floor area from a “granting lot" located in the East Midtown Subdistrict; and WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 81-643(b) and 81-642 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have jointly filed an application, designated N 210219 ZCM and N 210220 ZCM, dated December 10, 2020 (the “Application") to the CPC Chairperson to allow, by certification, (a) retaining 40,909 square feet of non-complying floor area existing on the Development Site to increase the maximum floor area permitted on the Receiving Lot from 175,110 square feet to 216,019 square feet and (b) the distribution of 36,139.4 square feet of floor area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot; and WHEREAS, the distribution of floor area from the Granting Lot to the Receiving Lot reduces the maximum floor area permitted on the Granting Lot from 647,703 square feet to 611,563.6 square feet and increases the maximum floor area permitted on the Receiving Lot from 216,019 square feet to 252,158.4 square feet; and WHEREAS, the CPC Chairperson has certified the Application, thereby reducing the permitted maximum floor area on the Granting Lot to 611,563.6 and increasing the permitted maximum floor area on the Receiving Lot to 252,158.4 square feet. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained, it is hereby agreed as follows: 2
